note: Mechanical contract: every part the case must house, with its body from the datasheet. Units mm. Frame for suggested positions = pocket.json (x right from the case's leftmost point, y from the back (0) to the player (100), z up from the table). status: final = datasheet drawing read; conferir = distributor figure, estimate, or the exact order code is still open. needs_from_design = what the case must provide. The design owns the positions; the numbers under 'suggested' are only where the electronics would put the part given pocket.json v2.

volume_pot.name: Potenciometro de volume com chave (liga/desliga no inicio do curso)
volume_pot.part_number: Alps RK097 single, horizontal type, with SPST switch (KiCad Potentiometer_Alps_RK097_Single_Horizontal_Switch), 10 k log (A); LCSC option ALPSALPINE RK0971221Z05
volume_pot.lcsc: C336003 (Alps RK0971221Z05, 60 in stock 17 Oct 2026; taper and shaft to conferir)
volume_pot.solution: SPEC 3 option 1: 9 mm switched pot, HORIZONTAL type (shaft parallel to its own PCB), soldered on a small VERTICAL board (perpendicular to the lid). The shaft points up through the lid; the threaded bushing is clamped to the lid by its M7 nut. The body (15.8 along the shaft, switch included) hangs from just under the lid down to z ~14.5, i.e. inside the z range the controls board already uses (14.08-30.18), so the lid does NOT rise.

body.shaft: D6, L = 20 from the body face (footprint drawing; L 15 also sold)
body.terminals: pot 1-3 in a row 5 mm below the body face (pitch 2.5), switch 4/5 11.25 below it (pitch 5)

volume_pot.mounting: shaft vertical (z); its PCB vertical in the x-z plane BEHIND the shaft; body towards the player
volume_pot.lid: hole D7.3 for the bushing + M7 thin nut on top (or under a knob skirt); blind hole D1.2 x 1.5 for the anti-rotation pin, or the pin is clipped off
volume_pot.knob: D9 knob on a D6 knurled shaft, same as the RK09K: works. Shaft tip at z 45.3 (L 15): 12.3 above the lid surface (z 33); the knob bore must take >= 8 of shaft (conferir with the knob).
volume_pot.electrical: 5 wires to the controls board: pot CW (VCC), wiper (POT, pin 22), CCW (GND), switch S1/S2 (power on/off, signal-level: a few mA, the switch is NOT in the load path)
volume_pot.keepouts: the controls board needs a cutout round the pot body (x 9.4-21, y 40.5-55): its left end becomes the vertical pot board, joined at 90 deg by a tab through a slot with 5 solder pads (or 5 short wires)

alternatives_rejected.16 mm with switch (Alpha RV16 / Vishay P: body D16-17 and 13-17 along the shaft with the switch can: not lower than the 9 mm one and wider; with the encoder 16 mm away the two bodies leave ~1 mm
alternatives_rejected.9 mm VERTICAL type on the existing contr: 16.6 above the board: needs the board 3.6 lower, onto the Audio Board

volume_pot.needs_from_design: lid boss with the D7.3 hole and the anti-rotation hole at the volume knob; room for the vertical pot board at y 40.9-42.5 from z 13.8 up; confirm nothing at z 14.5-17.2 under the pot (D1 had the controls board there only)
volume_pot.note_e2b: E2b uses the Alps RK097 drawing (body 13.3 along the shaft, not the RK0972S's 15.8): the body ends at z 17.0, above the controls board (17.18 top) only by the switch legs, which sit at z 19.05.
volume_pot.pot_board_v4: v0.2 (F2 follow-up, design question 5): the pot board was drawn mirrored (KiCad X = 55 - y). Seen from the pot's side (F face towards -x) the player (+y) is on the right because the SPEC frame is left-handed, so X = y - 43. Fixed: the joint's GND pad now lands on the controls board's GND pad at y 46.4 (before it met the net-less pad at 51.6). The shaft stays at y 49 (symmetric); pot pins: 3 (VCC) at y 46.5, 2 (wiper) at 49.0, 1 (GND) at 51.5, switch 5/4 at 46.5/51.5. Rotation sense was NOT affected: it is set by the part's own terminals (Alps: CW seen from the shaft end moves the wiper from 1 to 3, conferir), and 3 = VCC, so turning clockwise seen from above raises the volume. Cable wires 1-5: JW pads unchanged by net (JW1 VCC, JW2 POT, JW3 GND, JW4 PWR_A, JW5 PWR_B), only their physical order along y is now JW5, JW1, JW2, JW3, JW4 from y 44.2 to 53.0.
volume_pot.nut_v5: The RK0972S / RK097 drawings give only the bushing thread (M7 x 0.75, bushing 5 or 7 long); the nut is NOT dimensioned there. Typical M7 x 0.75 thin nut for 9 mm pots: 9-10 AF x 2.0 (conferir with the bought part). Design: size the lid recess for 10 AF (11.6 across corners) x 2.0 so either fits.
volume_pot.anti_rotation_v5: anti-rotation pin clipped off (envelope anti_rotation_hole = null); the M7 nut holds it.

encoder.part_number: Alps EC11E with push switch, 15 pulses / 15 detents, flatted D6 shaft L = 25 (SPEC v5 F3: with the D14 x 14 knob L 20 engages only 5.2, L 25 gives 8.0); exact EC11E1520xxx/25-mm suffix conferir at Alps/Mouser; fallback: L 30 cut to 25 with a hacksaw
encoder.mounting: vertical on the controls board (top), shaft up through the lid
encoder.note_v5: Shaft L 25 chosen (F4) for the design's D14 x 14 knob (8.0 mm engagement >= 8).

led.name: LED bicolor vermelho/verde, catodo comum, 3 mm

body.leads: 3 x 0.5 sq, pitch 2.54, cathode in the middle

led.mounting: on the controls board top, on a ~10 mm spacer so the dome reaches the lid hole (or a light pipe)
led.electrical: red = charge light (BQ24074 CHG) OR Teensy pin 13 through a dual Schottky; green = pin 5

controls_connector.name: Conector da plaquinha dos knobs (10 vias)
controls_connector.part_number: main board: JST SH BM10B-SRSS-TB (top) + 10-way SH cable ~100 mm crimped at that end; far end cut and soldered: wires 1-5 to the pot board (back face, z ~28.6), wires 6-10 to the controls board's right edge (top)
controls_connector.pins: 1 VCC 2 POT 3 GND 4 PWR_A 5 PWR_B 6 ENC_A 7 ENC_B 8 ENC_SW 9 LED_R 10 LED_G
controls_connector.mounting: on the controls board TOP side near its right edge (a downward header like the eTuttino's PH would hit the Audio Board, which runs under the controls board); the cable leaves upwards, bends towards +x under the lid and drops past the board's right edge to the main board
controls_connector.needs_from_design: room for 5 wires leaving the pot board's back face at z ~28.6 (above the encoder, under the lid) and 5 leaving the controls board's right edge at y 45-53; both bundles join the SH-10 that drops to J_CTL
controls_connector.why: a BM10B with its two lugs needs 12.8 + 1.0 mm along y and the controls board has 13.5; and the LED with the two lid posts beside it walls the encoder off from the board's right edge, so the pot's lines take the pot board

headphone_jack.name: Jack de fone 3,5 estereo de PAINEL com contato de comutacao na ponta (ligado por fios)
headphone_jack.part_number: Cliff FC681375V (stereo switched 3.5 mm, ring nut M8 x 0.75) - or FC681375VH (hex nut)
headphone_jack.status: final (Cliff drawing read 18 Oct 2026; stock conferir)

datasheet_dims.body_note: 10.5 across (the axis 5.0 from one face, 5.5 from the other), 9.0 across (axis centred), 13.0 long behind the thread's shoulder
datasheet_dims.nut: ring nut D10.0 x 2.0 (with a 1.0 spanner slot) or hex nut 10 A/F x 2.0
datasheet_dims.tabs: 4 solder tabs 1.0 x 1.5 with hole, 4.0 out of the body's back face
datasheet_dims.terminals: 1 = S (sleeve), 2 = R (ring), 3 = T (tip), 4 = tip switch (closed to 3 with no plug, opens when a plug goes in)

headphone_jack.panel_hole: D8.2 through, in a FLAT area: inside >= 11 x 10 for the body's front face, outside >= D11 for the nut
headphone_jack.behind_wall: body 13.0 + tabs 4.0 + wires ~4 = ~21 along the axis, 10.5 x 9.0 section (tabs on the back face)
headphone_jack.anti_rotation: none on the part: the nut clamps it; a flat boss or a printed rib beside the body's 10.5 face stops it turning
headphone_jack.mounting: from inside, thread through the wall, nut outside (ring nut tightened with its slot)
headphone_jack.electrical: 4 x 28-30 AWG wires, ~60-80 mm, to J_JACK on the main board: 1 S -> HP_VGND (Audio Board virtual ground, NEVER GND), 2 R -> HP_R, 3 T -> HP_L, 4 tip switch -> HP_TIPSW (-> HP_DET, pin 17). The Audio Board's own jack pads keep feeding J_HP as before (HP_L/HP_R/HP_VGND), so the panel jack and the amplifier input meet on the main board.
headphone_jack.needs_from_design: D8.2 hole in a flat area on the back-left wall (wall 1.0-2.5 there), ~21 mm straight room behind it along the axis, 10.5 x 9.0 section, + a wire path to J_JACK (main board, connector_zones.back_left)
headphone_jack.replaces: Same Sky SJ1-3525N (PCB jack on the removed panel board)
headphone_jack.note_f3: Design F3 places the jack rotated (9 wide x 10.5 tall), axis +x, z ~23.8, on its own facet at y ~38: fine electrically (orientation is free). The wall at the jack hole must be <= 2.5 (thread 4.5 - nut 2.0); if the facet is 3.0 thick, spot-face it from inside to <= 2.5 over D11.

battery.name: LiPo 1S 1000 mAh tipo 603450 com PCM e NTC (3 fios)
battery.part_number: 603450 3-wire with 10 k NTC (B 3435): e.g. EEMB LP603450 ordered with the NTC lead, or a 603450 3-wire pack (zengtrader, 1200 mAh, eBay 112702247608); fallback that also fits: Core Electronics CE06795 (1000 mAh, NTC, PCM, 7 x 30 x 50, JST-PH 3)

body.wire: 3 x ~60 mm (+, -, NTC) to a JST PH 2.0 3-pin plug

battery.mounting: flat on the bottom, PCM end towards the wire exit; held by the bottom plate + a foam pad (no glue on the cell)
battery.cable_exits: from the PCM end (one short side): ~60 mm to the main board's JST PH 3 (B3B-PH-K-S, LCSC C131339)
battery.electrical: NTC (10 k at 25 C, B 3435) between TS and GND of the BQ24074: charge stops below 0 C and above 45 C. Pinout of the plug varies between sellers: check before connecting.
battery.needs_from_design: cradle 7.6 x 36.5 x 58.5 (the SPEC's 7 x 36 x 58 + 8 % swelling in thickness only; cells swell in thickness) off the main board, reached from the bottom; a 6 x 4 channel for the 3 wires to the main board

battery_plug.part: JST PHR-3 housing + 3 SPH-002T-P0.5S crimps (comes on the battery)

pigtail_end.part: in-line PH 2.0 3-way 'male' (pin) housing on the extension cable (not a JST part)

mated.latch: PHR-3 has no latch; friction ~5 N

pocket_min.note: mated pair + ~1 each side; wires leave axially at both ends: 3 mm straight before the bend

pigtail.part: JST PH 2.0 3-way extension, male-female, 100 mm (cut to ~70)
pigtail.route: J_BAT (main board top, x 12.6 y 32-36) -> pigtail_way_in -> pocket

speaker.name: Alto-falante Same Sky CLS0361-L152

body.terminal_glue_blob: at the rim, ~6 wide, ~3 out of the frame (conferir)

speaker.mounting: cone (flat side) towards the grille, the rim glued or clamped on a gasket ring; magnet backwards. No screw holes. Back volume 8-12 cm3 CLOSED and SEALED, nothing else inside it.
speaker.cable_exits: 2 x 28 AWG wires, 152 mm, from the rim (red +, black -), sealed where they leave the back box (glue), to the main board's JST PH 2 (B2B-PH-K-S) or soldered pads
speaker.electrical: 8 ohm, 2 W (3 W max), Fo 450 Hz, 88 dB 1 W/0.5 m. Driven by the PAM8302A (0.65 W at 3.6 V).

main_board_connectors.name: Conectores na placa principal (para o design reservar a saida dos cabos)

main_board_connectors.note: placed in E2b (pcb/build_pocket_pcb.py); J_BAT/J_SPK/J_PNL in back_left (checked against levels and the micro-B plug), J_CTL in its connector zone
main_board_connectors.note_v5: v5 (F4): J_PNL (SH-8 to the panel board) removed; J_VBUS (1 wire pad with strain-relief hole) and J_JACK (4 wire pads, 2.54) in connector_zones.back_left. Positions written by build_pocket_pcb.py's run (see ELETRONICA.md F4).
main_board_connectors.heights_v5: J_VBUS (wire pad, x 18.5 y 18.0) and J_JACK (4 wire pads x 18.5, y 28.6-36.2): copper + solder + wire bend <= 3.0 above the board top = z <= 10.7, under z_top_max_under_jack 18.4 (y > 33.2) and the back_left z_top_max 21.9. Confirmed.

charge_light.name: Luz de carga so com o Pocket DESLIGADO (SPEC v4 mudanca 10)
charge_light.note: no case impact. Main board: BQ24074 CHG -> AO3401A Q30 (gate, 100 k to VBUS) -> 1 k -> BAT54C D30 -> LED_R; NEW Q31 AO3400A (LCSC C20917) drain on the 1 k's far end (CHGA), source GND, gate = 3.3 V rail: when the Pocket is on the 3.3 V rail turns Q31 on and it shunts the charge light (5 mA from USB, not from the battery); off, the rail is 0 V (TPS63001 load disconnect, VUSB-VIN cut) and the red lights while charging.

controls_board.name: Plaquinha dos knobs (E2b)
controls_board.outline: envelope rect x 23.22-50.6, y 42.5-56.0 PLUS two tabs at x 27.0-35.2: y 40.0-42.5 (back) and y 56.0-57.5 (front). UNCHANGED in v4.
controls_board.why: the EC11E's legs span 17 mm along y (A/B/C 7.5 behind the shaft, the switch 7 in front, 2 mm pads); no rotation fits 13.5 mm (rot 0/180 put legs into the pot board)
controls_board.led: 3 mm LED legs along x (40.58 / 43.12 / 45.66 at y 49) so the lines pass between the lid posts
controls_board.needs_from_design: the speaker box wall must stay at y >= 57.8 (0.3 clear) for x 26.7-35.5 and z 14.0-17.5, or the box roof below z 14.0 there

back.below: encoder A/B/C legs 1.5 below (z >= 14.08), over the Audio Board (top z 12.3): 1.8 clear
back.copper: pads A/B/C at y 41.5 (D2.0), board edge 40.0

front.below: switch legs S1/S2 at y 56.0, 1.5 below (z >= 14.08)
front.copper: pads S1/S2 at (28.62, 56.0) and (33.62, 56.0), D2.0; the tab cannot be shorter than y 57.3 (0.3 copper to edge)

main_board.name: Placa principal (E2b)
main_board.note: 4 layers (In1 GND plane, In2 3.3 V plane). Back side: all ICs and passives (max 2.0 tall, inductor 2.0); top: switches, the Audio Board legs, J_BAT/J_SPK (PH THT), J_PNL/J_CTL (SH SMD), J_HP wire pads.
main_board.note_v4: v4: Q31 (charge light only when off) and Q22 + R26 (with USB present the volume switch alone holds the 3.3 V on, so the Teensy can be flashed and tested without the Pocket firmware) added on the back; TPS63001 kept; no change to the outline, the top connectors or any height.
main_board.note_v5: v5 (F4): VBUS now arrives by wire from the Teensy's VUSB pad (J_VBUS); TVS D60 (SMF5.0A) on VBUS at the BQ24074 input; panel jack wires to J_JACK; no panel board. 4 layers, 1.2 mm, outline from the envelope.

vusb_wire.name: Fio do VBUS: pad VUSB do Teensy -> J_VBUS da placa principal (entrada do carregador)
vusb_wire.part_number: silicone or PTFE hook-up wire 26 AWG (0.13 mm2), OD <= 1.2, red, ~50 mm
vusb_wire.status: conferir (pad position on the real Teensy)
vusb_wire.from: the Teensy 4.0's VUSB pad on its BOTTOM side, at the USB end next to the VIN-row edge (PJRC back-side card, 'VUSB', beside the 'cut to separate VIN from VUSB' pads); soldered BEFORE the Teensy goes on the Audio Board (low stack), after cutting VUSB-VIN
vusb_wire.route: out of the gap between the Teensy and the Audio Board at the USB end (the header strips close the long sides), over the Audio Board's left edge (x 30), down to the main board (z 7.7) and left to J_VBUS; it stays below z 14.0 under the micro-B plug's overmould
vusb_wire.strain_relief: drop of epoxy / hot glue over the wire on the Teensy's bottom, 2-3 mm from the pad; on the main board the wire goes through J_VBUS's relief hole before its solder hole
vusb_wire.current: <= 500 mA (BQ24074 USB500 input limit) + ~5 mA charge light; 26 AWG: ~0.13 ohm/m, 50 mm = 7 mOhm, 3.5 mV drop at 500 mA
vusb_wire.needs_from_design: a ~1.2 mm wire from the Teensy's USB end down past the Audio Board's left edge to J_VBUS (back_left zone)

micro_b_panel_cable.name: Extensao micro-B de painel em FPC (fita chata): macho micro-B 90 graus 'UP' no Teensy -> femea micro-B presa na parede
micro_b_panel_cable.decision: FPC flat ribbon (design's proposal, F3): the round screw-ear cable (OD 3.5-4.5, R >= 18, 25-30 cm) does not fit: inside the Pocket R 18 is impossible and the free height over the Teensy is only z 19.5-30.5.
micro_b_panel_cable.part_number: FPV 'Flat Slim Thin Ribbon FPC Cable Micro USB 90 Degree Angled Up Male to Micro USB Female Receptacle', 10 cm (Permanent / generic FPV brand; same listing sold in 5, 10, 15 cm)
micro_b_panel_cable.source: Amazon (Permanent): 15 cm https://www.amazon.com/Ribbon-Degree-Angled-Receptacle-Charging/dp/B07Q61KTT7 ; 5 cm https://www.amazon.com/Ribbon-Degree-Angled-Female-Charging/dp/B07Q9YBC99 ; also AliExpress 'FPV FPC micro USB 90 up male to micro USB female'. Buy the 10 cm (or 15 cm and fold the extra flat); buy one 'DOWN' too as a spare in case the Teensy's receptacle is the other way up (a few dollars).
micro_b_panel_cable.datasheet: none published (FPV accessory): every dimension below is a seller figure or an estimate -> conferir with the bought part before the case is printed
micro_b_panel_cable.status: conferir (no drawing exists for this family; measure on arrival)

ribbon.fold: can be folded flat (crease) once at assembly; static bend R >= 1.5 recommended, never flexed in use
ribbon.conductors: USB 2.0 (VBUS, D+, D-, GND, ID), 480 Mbit/s per the sellers; unshielded: keep the ribbon away from the TPS63001 inductor L10 (main board x 93.6 y 10) and the PAM8302A

male_90.kind: 'UP' angled: the ribbon leaves from the plug's top face (the trapezoid's wide side), perpendicular to the Teensy board, i.e. straight UP (+z) out of the plug body
male_90.head: ~11 x 8.5 x 5.5 overmould incl. the metal plug's back end (conferir); metal plug 6.85 x 1.8, 6.3 long
male_90.why_up: the plug's sides are boxed in (case column at (25, 6.5) and back wall on -y; tab, encoder, jack and female body on +y): the ribbon goes up from the plug top (z 21.85) into the free space z 19.5-30.5 and folds flat towards the female
male_90.orientation_check: the Teensy 4.0's micro-B has the trapezoid's WIDE side away from the Teensy board (towards the Teensy's top) (conferir on the J's Teensy before ordering: look into the receptacle). If it is the other way, the 'DOWN' version is the one that leaves upwards.

female.kind: micro-B receptacle on a small stiffened head at the ribbon's end, NO screw ears or holes (conferir)
female.head: ~12 x 9 x 4.0 (W x L x H, conferir); receptacle opening 7.5 x 2.6 in its front face, wide side up
female.fixing: printed clamp of the case: the head sits in a pocket on the flat inner boss, front face against the wall's inner face, and a printed strap (or the clamp plate) with 2 x M2 x 5 self-tapping screws at 16 mm pitch (one each side of the head) presses it on the boss; a 0.5 mm lip in front of the head takes the plug insertion force (~20 N) and the withdrawal pull
female.screws: 2 x M2 x 5 self-tapping for plastic (kit BOM)

panel_cutout.why: the user's plug overmould (~10.5 x 7, varies) must enter the wall to reach full mating depth (metal plug only 6.3 long) with the 3.0 wall the design has at the hole

micro_b_panel_cable.behind_wall: female head ~9 deep along the axis + ribbon leaving its back face (flat, folds immediately)
micro_b_panel_cable.length: 10 cm (5 cm too short, 15 cm folds once more flat): from the female (axis z 26.4, design) back over the plug to its top face
micro_b_panel_cable.electrical: VBUS, D+, D-, GND straight through. Charge (<= 500 mA via the BQ24074), MIDI and flashing.
micro_b_panel_cable.needs_from_design: flat boss with the 12 x 8 R1 hole (wall 3.0 ok), a pocket ~12.4 x 9.4 x 4.4 for the female head + a clamp/strap with 2 x M2 at 16 mm pitch and a front lip; ribbon path from the head's back face to the plug top (flat, any fold R >= 1.5), clear of L10; room over the plug for the UP head (~11 x 8.5 x 5.5)

rejected_round_cable.part: screw-ear micro-B panel extension with 90 deg male (female as Premier/Adafruit P3258: flange 25.5 x 10, ears D3.5 at 17.3, 26.1 long, cable OD 4.5)
rejected_round_cable.why: OD 3.5-4.5 needs R >= 18 and is sold >= 25 cm; the design measured R ~7 at the plug and ~13 in the loop as the best possible

needs_from_design_v5: panel board REMOVED: drop envelope 'panel' (board, holes H1/H2, rib, front ledge, lid post/pin) and its boss

micro_b_panel_cable (FPC): 12 x 8 R1 hole (wall 3.0 ok), pocket ~12.4 x 9.4 x 4.4 for the female head, clamp/strap with 2 x M2 at 16 mm pitch + front lip; flat ribbon path from the head to the plug top, clear of L10; UP male head ~11 x 8.5 x 5.5 over the Teensy's receptacle

headphone_jack (Cliff FC681375V): D8.2 hole in a flat area, wall <= 2.5 at the hole (spot-face inside if the facet is 3.0), ~21 straight room behind, 10.5 x 9.0 section, nut D10 x 2.0 outside; rotated as F3 is fine
vusb_wire: ~1.2 mm wire path from the Teensy's USB end down past the Audio Board's left edge to J_VBUS
connector_zones.back_left: keep it (J_BAT, J_SPK, J_VBUS, J_JACK); nothing above it now but the cables
